title: Creator
subtitle: Author plugins, skills, hooks, presets and workflows inside an authoring root.

gate.title: Developer mode required
gate.description: Creator can write files and change permissions, so it is only offered when developer mode is on.

root.title: Authoring root
root.description: Every file Creator reads or writes stays inside this directory. There is no implicit default.

rejected.filesystem-root: The filesystem root cannot be an authoring root.
rejected.home-directory: Your home directory is too broad to be an authoring root.

permissions.title: Permission diff
permissions.none: This artifact asks for no new capabilities.
permissions.requiresApproval: {count, plural, one {# new capability needs your approval} other {# new capabilities need your approval}}
permissions.stale: The proposal changed since you approved it. Review it again.
permissions.writesBlocked: Files cannot be written until this is approved.

preview.title: Sandbox preview
preview.leaked: {count, plural, one {# resource was not released} other {# resources were not released}}: {labels}

review.title: Independent review
review.readOnly: The reviewer runs read-only, with its own context.

run.advanceHint: Runs forward until the workflow needs you.
